title: Double Helix Effect: AI-Driven Cross-Cultural Cognitive Simulation and China's Layered International Influence Communication Model

contributions.purpose: 用 LLM 替代高成本跨国民调做跨文化认知模拟
contributions.mechanism: CPCCS 方法:把 Hofstede 六维文化维度转成 LLM 提示参数,三层建模架构,模拟 14 国 ×12 影响维度
contributions.evaluation: 与 400 份传统问卷核心指标一致性 >80%(US 84%/UK 80%/PK 86%/KR 81%),效度系数 ρ≤0.1;结构效度 KMO=0.847,方差解释 72.4%
contributions.domain: 计算社会科学/国际传播
contributions.source_quote: We develop the Culture-Parameterized Cross-National Cognitive Simulation (CPCCS) method, combining Hofstede's cultural dimension theory with advanced AI technology to create a scalable framework for cross-cultural cognitive assessment.

contributions.purpose: 刻画中国国际影响力的传播结构
contributions.mechanism: 12 维影响力描述性统计,提出传统文化符号与现代发展议题交织的‘双螺旋’模式
contributions.evaluation: 历史维度居首 2.3 分、环境维度 2.2 分;历史维度标准差仅 0.18,气候议题得 3.8 分
contributions.source_quote: China's international influence transmission presents a unique "double helix" pattern—traditional cultural symbols and modern development issues intertwine and synergistically act.

contributions.purpose: 揭示跨国接受度的分层差异
contributions.mechanism: 基于 12 维影响分的层次聚类(欧氏距离,Ward 连接),归纳四类接受模式
contributions.evaluation: 聚类效度轮廓系数 0.68、交叉验证稳定性 >85%;巴基斯坦经济/技术/政治维度满分 4.0
contributions.source_quote: Hierarchical clustering analysis based on China's influence scores across 12 dimensions identifies four typical influence acceptance patterns.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This study confirms deep interaction and synergistic relationships between them, enriching Nye's (2004) soft power theory.

The "layered differentiation" influence distribution pattern provides micro-mechanism explanations for constructivist international relations theory. Wendt's (1999) "ideas construct reality" theory receives specific quantitative validation in this study.

notes: 数据红旗:核心‘验证’是循环自证——LLM 模拟各国民众态度,再拿‘400 份传统问卷样本’声称一致性>80%,但问卷数据不公开(‘upon request’)、无代码,无法核实;维度间相关出现精确 r=0.00(学术vs政治)、r=-0.50 等可疑整数值。非实证适配问题:四元组勉强套用,但 evaluation 全是模拟输出而非真实世界测量。checklist AI 披露矛盾:自报 AI 仅 25-35% 参与、‘manuscript primarily written by human’(Hypothesis B/设计 C/写作 B),与 Agents4Science‘AI 为主作者’前提相悖。无算力披露。内容政治敏感(中国国际影响力布道)。reject。
